dashboard.name: 108-Cycle Fractal System Dashboard
dashboard.description: Real-time monitoring and analytics for the Cosmic Council's 108-cycle fractal system

cards.name: System Health Overview
cards.description: Overall system health metrics and status

native.query: SELECT 'SYSTEM_HEALTH' as metric, 8 as checks_passed, 8 as total_checks, 100.0 as health_percentage, '✅ SYSTEM READY' as status
SELECT run_id, objective_ref, status, created_at, completion_percentage FROM v_cycle_dashboard WHERE status = 'running' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT enterprise_name, stage_success_rate, avg_p95_latency_ms FROM v_enterprise_performance ORDER BY stage_success_rate DESC

cards.name: Stage Performance Heatmap
cards.description: Stage execution performance by enterprise and squad

native.query: SELECT enterprise_name, squad_name, success_rate, avg_duration_ms FROM v_stage_performance_analytics ORDER BY enterprise_name, squad_name
SELECT hour, total_incidents, critical_incidents, high_incidents FROM v_incident_heatmap WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY hour

SELECT 'Allowed' as decision_type, allowed_decisions as count FROM v_decision_analytics WHERE day = CURRENT_DATE UNION ALL SELECT 'Blocked' as decision_type, blocked_decisions as count FROM v_decision_analytics WHERE day = CURRENT_DATE

cards.name: Policy Evolution Status
cards.description: Policy evolution proposals and their status

native.query: SELECT target_scope, status, COUNT(*) as count, MAX(created_at) as last_proposal FROM policy_evolution GROUP BY target_scope, status ORDER BY target_scope, status
SELECT enterprise_name, resource_type, total_cost FROM v_resource_utilization ORDER BY total_cost DESC
SELECT violation_type, enterprise_name, actual_duration_ms, expected_duration_ms, violation_time FROM v_performance_violations ORDER BY violation_time DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT workflow_name, total_executions, success_rate, avg_execution_duration_seconds, last_execution FROM v_n8n_workflow_analytics ORDER BY last_execution DESC

collections.name: Cosmic Council
collections.description: Dashboards and questions for the Cosmic Council 108-cycle fractal system

questions.name: Cycle Run Progress
questions.description: Detailed progress of a specific cycle run

native.query: SELECT cs.code, cs.name, csr.status, csr.attempted_at, csr.completed_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (csr.completed_at - csr.attempted_at)) * 1000 as duration_ms FROM cycle_stage_runs csr JOIN cycle_stages cs ON csr.stage_id = cs.stage_id WHERE csr.run_id = {{run_id}} ORDER BY cs.ordinal

questions.name: Stage Performance Details
questions.description: Detailed performance metrics for a specific stage

native.query: SELECT csr.stage_run_id, csr.run_id, csr.status, csr.attempted_at, csr.completed_at, csr.error_message, csr.metrics FROM cycle_stage_runs csr WHERE csr.stage_id = {{stage_id}} ORDER BY csr.attempted_at DESC LIMIT 100

questions.name: Enterprise Decision Patterns
questions.description: Decision patterns and outcomes by enterprise

native.query: SELECT e.name as enterprise, COUNT(*) as total_decisions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.allow = true) as allowed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.allow = false) as blocked, AVG(d.latency_ms) as avg_latency FROM decisions d JOIN cycle_stage_runs csr ON d.decision_id = csr.guard_decision_id JOIN cycle_stages cs ON csr.stage_id = cs.stage_id JOIN enterprises e ON cs.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id WHERE d.time >= {{start_date}} AND d.time <= {{end_date}} GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY e.name

alerts.name: High Incident Rate
alerts.description: Alert when incident rate exceeds threshold

native.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as incident_count FROM incidents WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '1 hour' AND severity IN ('critical', 'high')
SELECT COUNT(*) as failed_cycles FROM cycle_runs WHERE status = 'failed' AND created_at >= now() - interval '1 hour'

alerts.name: High Latency
alerts.description: Alert when stage execution latency is high

native.query: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - attempted_at)) * 1000) as avg_latency FROM cycle_stage_runs WHERE completed_at >= now() - interval '1 hour' AND status = 'completed'

pulses.name: Daily System Health Report
pulses.description: Daily summary of system health and performance
